subject: the pre-move adapter classification and its post-P0d source disposition

classification_source.reason: The classification predates P0d, so its exact measured bytes are retained in-tree; content identity proves what was measured without requiring commit history.

criterion.mapping: The function's direct responsibility is structural representation transfer between edi and crysta values, labels, identities, callbacks, or result records. Selecting a corresponding field from source representation metadata is mapping when it synthesises no value or product policy.
criterion.logic: The function directly introduces any default or fallback, validation or refusal, inference or completion, canonical format/cache policy, calculation/refinement orchestration, derived metric, or write-back policy. Mixed functions are classified logic; a wrapper is not made logic solely because a called conversion helper contains logic.

derivation: Named definitions are the unindented source lines matching ^[A-Za-z_][^;=]*\(. Function spans run from that signature's first opening brace through its balanced closing brace, inclusive; comments and string/character literals do not affect brace depth.
